compatibility_contract.abstain: Do not create a compatibility target or demote the source score; report coverage separately.
compatibility_contract.bidirectional_compatibility: May provide positive and negative calibration examples after mechanism review.
compatibility_contract.bounded_direct_multiplier: For the development diagnostic, directly observable rows use m(e)=0.5+C(e), yielding a parameter-free [0.5,1.5] multiplier with neutral point C=0.5.
compatibility_contract.neutral_fallback: m(e)=1 for abstained rows, so S(e)=Z(e).
compatibility_contract.positive_compatibility_only: May reward directly observed contact but may not infer violation from absent contact.

design_goal: Separate predicate semantics, physical mechanism, and observability so that ambiguity is not treated as a physical subtype or a calibration label.

leakage_boundary.class_context_rule: Endpoint class may identify a candidate surface category for routing, but is never sufficient evidence of validity.

promotion_boundary.connected_to_rule: Do not fit a bidirectional connected-to calibrator until the annotation ontology distinguishes direct from mediated connections.
requires_before_refit: blind mechanism/observability review of the frozen queue
train/internal-dev coverage for every promoted mechanism
policy targets constructed independently of the final Violation verifier
source metrics and paired family-wise confidence intervals after a new model hash
